html: † [כִּידוֹד] n.m. spark (from above √, = strike out a spark, according to Thes RobGes, cf. Sta§ 216 (doubtfully), LagBN 182 Köii. 147, § 71. 1; NH כִּדּוֹד = rod (of iron, etc.); כִּדּוֹדִיּוֹת שֶׁל אֵשׁ i.e. red-hot rods; but BaNB § 142, 139 der. this and כַּדְכֹּד from √ כיד = Arabic كيد, كَادَ emit fire (said of a fire-stick, زَنْدٌ, Lane2639 b, cf. 1257 b), and so Buhl)—only pl. cstr. כִּידוֹדֵי אֵשׁ Jb 41:11 of breath of crocodile (‖ לַפִּידִים).
